# Hearth-keeping

Keep the hearth: when a fault is mended, the mending is written down so the next hand does
not have to rediscover it.

## The craft

A fix note answers four questions, in this order: what was wrong, why nothing caught it,
what now stands, and how it was proven. Proof is a command whose output was recorded, never
an adjective.

## Templates

- `templates/fix-note.md` — the shape of a fix note.
